main_text.head: TVRMA ÆTHIOPVM.
main_text.p:
FAma tua virtutis ad hæc nos littora traxit
Vnde venit calidi mollior aura Noti.
Fama tui reges tanto super altior omnes,
Quàm tuus à nostro dissidet ore color.
Ergo ubicunque libet devotis utere dextris,
Sive magis ratibus, sive placebit equis.
Experiare fidem bello vel pace licebit,
Serviet imperio vitaque morsque tuo.
main_text.head: TVRMA SEPTEMTRIONALIVM Equitum.
main_text.p:
NEc minus Arctoas sparsa est tua fama per oras,
Nec minus Eoas, occiduasque domos,
Quàm per inaccessas Libya squalentis arenas,
Nec minus hoc cœlo pectora tangit honos.
Sunt animi, sunt dextra animis servire parata,
Et mens imperium prompta subire tuum.
Si Fortuna animis fuerit si viribus æqua,
Officiis in te non prior Vllus erit.
main_text.head: A NEPTVNO MISSA TVRMA.
main_text.p:
NYmpha inter pulcras pulcerrima Neptuninas
Nympha Caledonia gloria magna tua.
Sola opibus digna Oceani, cum murice gemmis,
Quaque arbor facta est Gorgone facta lapis.
Nos tibi cæruleis Triton submisit ab undis,
Iussit & hæc domini nomine ferre sui.
Vtere Neptuno, ceu viribus est opus unda,
Sive ratis celeris, sive erit usus equi.

page.notes: Marginal and running text is clear. The initial letters F and N are large woodcut-style initials joined to the first word. Lines are shown with line breaks inside each stanza; the printed lines are set in italic type throughout the verse, which is not marked here. Some letters in the scan are faint, particularly in "Arctoas" and "Quaque", but they were read as printed.
